text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in portions at a gain felt rewarding, but I should decide how much to sell based on my plan, not just the pleasure of locking in a profit.","My average cost is personal history, not a guide to what a stock is worth now; I should avoid letting it dictate each trade.","I rarely check my account, so I should make a simple plan for reviewing holdings and cash rather than relying on occasional reactions to price moves."]}
